messages:
Ana (People Ops): Thanks everyone for joining the all-hands earlier. Quick follow-up thread for the people-ops questions that came up — promotions, leveling, comp, benefits. Drop any open Qs here and we'll triage. We plan to publish a short FAQ by EOD Friday.

Chris (Eng): When will promo decisions be communicated for IC3 -> IC4? Any change in timeline from last year?

Ana (People Ops): Good q — target timeline: manager sign-offs by 1774065600 (June 15), official letters to folks by 1774142000 (June 25). No process change but managers get a calibration guide.

Mike (SRE): Is there any retroactive comp adjustment for promos that were applied earlier this year?

Emma (HRBP): Short answer: not normally. Retroactive adjustments are exceptional. If you think you were missed, submit a case to case@people-ops with manager sign-off and we’ll review.

Jisoo (Eng-ML): Will there be a new leveling rubric for eng-ml? Current rubric feels light on inference/serving expectations.

Ana (People Ops): Yep — research/eng-ml rubric draft will be posted next week for feedback. We’ll include inference-serving examples and suggested artifacts for evidencing impact.

Devon (PM): And comp cycle cadence — is merit pool timing still tied to fiscal Q3? Trying to plan for hiring banding.

Olga (People Ops): Affirmative — merit cycle aligned with finance calendar (Q3). Managers will get budget guidance by the end of next week.

Cody (Eng): Can we get clarity on coaching vs PIP? A few engineers asked whether informal coaching counts as official documentation.

Emma (HRBP): Coaching is manager-led and informal; we document conversations in 1:1 notes. PIP is formal and used when coaching hasn’t led to improvement. We’ll add a short doc to the handbook with examples.

Tasha (People Ops): We’ll compile all these and post a short FAQ + timeline in #people-ops and update the handbook page. If anyone needs an urgent 1:1 or thinks they missed a promo, DM me or Ana.

Devon (PM): Will managers get calibration rubrics and example writeups? Templates would help.

Ana (People Ops): Yes — templates for manager writeups and calibration notes will be uploaded to the manager drive by next Wednesday.

Mike (SRE): About benefits — any update on parental leave changes mentioned in the all-hands?

Olga (People Ops): We're still finalizing vendor details. No immediate change to current policy; expected update in July if approved. We’ll announce before rolling changes.

Cody (Eng): Is there a way to see how comp banding maps to levels? A visible chart would help for transparency.

Emma (HRBP): We can publish a high-level banding chart (no individual salaries) — will coordinate with finance and post a redacted view.

allhands-bot: Quick reminder: internal survey for rubric feedback -> https://forms.gle/feedback123 (please respond by EOD Friday). :spiral_note_pad:

Ana (People Ops): Thanks all — keep Qs coming. We'll lock answers into a FAQ and ping this thread when posted. If you want anonymity for a follow-up, use the survey or slack DM to Tasha. :thumbsup:
